_note: category: physical | special | status. accuracy null = never misses. effects[].chance is a percent (default 100). flags: contact, kick, bite, charge (two-turn), ignoresProtect. First-pass numbers; tune in play-testing.

ember_puff.name: Ember Puff
ember_puff.desc: Puffs a cloud of embers from its gills. May burn.

glassblow.name: Glassblow
glassblow.desc: Fires a molten glass bubble like a blowgun shot. May glaze the target, lowering Speed.

stoke.name: Stoke
stoke.desc: Stokes its belly furnace. Raises Sp. Atk.

kiln_vent.name: Kiln Vent
kiln_vent.desc: Opens the vent slits on its kiln belly. May burn.

molten_marbles.name: Molten Marbles
molten_marbles.desc: Juggles molten marbles at the target. Hits 2-4 times.

glass_bell.name: Glass Bell
glass_bell.desc: Traps the target in a molten bell, then shatters it. The leftover glass raises the user's Defense.

static_rub.name: Static Rub
static_rub.desc: Rubs its shell on the ground. Its next Spark move deals double damage.

spark_trail.name: Spark Trail
spark_trail.desc: Leaves a charged slime patch. May paralyse. (The switch-in hazard version comes with party switching.)

shell_in.name: Shell In
shell_in.desc: Hides in its shell. Raises Defense.

coil_tap.name: Coil Tap
coil_tap.desc: Taps the coil's arc gap. Raises Sp. Atk if the target is Metal.

iron_filings.name: Iron Filings
iron_filings.desc: Drags a cloud of filings across the target. May lower Defense.

rail_shell.name: Rail Shell
rail_shell.desc: Charges the rails for a turn, then fires a scrap slug.

sprout_swipe.name: Sprout Swipe
sprout_swipe.desc: A swipe with its sprout ears.

jitter_bounce.name: Jitter Bounce
jitter_bounce.desc: Bounces nervously in place. Raises Speed.

springy_hop.name: Springy Hop
springy_hop.desc: Springs off its heels before the target can move. Always goes first.

gust_kick.name: Gust Kick
gust_kick.desc: A kick fast enough to whistle.

fern_blade.name: Fern Blade
fern_blade.desc: Slashes with its serrated fern tail. High critical-hit ratio.

reap_kick.name: Reap Kick
reap_kick.desc: A scything kick. High critical-hit ratio. If it misses, the user's Speed rises.

bubble_snap.name: Bubble Snap
bubble_snap.desc: Snaps through a mouthful of bubbles.

throat_glow.name: Throat Glow
throat_glow.desc: Its throat sac flickers in the dark. Lowers the target's Attack.

needle_bite.name: Needle Bite
needle_bite.desc: Needle teeth from an underslung jaw. May lower Defense.

pressure_jet.name: Pressure Jet
pressure_jet.desc: Vents its pressure bladder in one blast.

abyssal_harpoon.name: Abyssal Harpoon
abyssal_harpoon.desc: Fires its jaw on stretched cartilage. Lowers the target's Speed; the user's Defense drops as the jaw resets.
